name_note: GTDB splits the classical genus Mogibacterium, and Mogibacterium_A is one of those parts, so the findings cited here are about Mogibacterium in the broad sense.

sentences.text: Mogibacterium is a genus of anaerobic, non-spore-forming, Gram-positive rod-shaped bacteria proposed for isolates from the periodontal pockets of adult human patients with periodontal disease and infected root canals.
The original isolates were inert in most conventional biochemical tests and phenotypically resembled asaccharolytic Eubacterium species.
Further Mogibacterium isolates were recovered from tongue plaque and necrotic dental pulp.

A study of 38 patients with major depressive disorder and 30 healthy controls reported that the relative abundance of the oral genus Mogibacterium in buccal mucosa was significantly altered in the patients.
